HistoryEnforcement.description: Actual worker containment capabilities. A true cooperative pacing feature is not proof of physical I/O enforcement. Preserve unknown capability metadata.

HistoryFilters.description: Immutable source scope. UTC microseconds are exact signed int64; start is inclusive, end is exclusive. If both times are set start must precede end; frequency bounds are inclusive and ordered. Omit optional fields to use the full selected dimension.

HistoryJob.description: Job status. Nullable fields are always present, including the full unsigned64 source boundary. Successful job identities and cursors address a sealed derived source, not a full archive backup.

HistoryJobList.description: At most one active job and 32 retained completed jobs; configured retention may be smaller.

HistoryJobResult.description: Derived output only. data retains operation-specific rows, opaque next_cursor and cache metadata; metrics and unknown nested JSON keys remain exact and open. Source measurements remain in the canonical archive.

HistoryMeasurementCursor.description: Exact original source ID and UTC timestamp; ordering uses exact UTF-8 ID bytes on a timestamp tie.

HistoryPageRequest.description: Only an optional opaque result cursor is accepted. Omission/null selects the first page on the same sealed source; a nonnull cursor must belong to that original query.

HistoryRequest.description: Typed derived job only: no SQL, executable, filesystem path or resource-policy fields. Filters default to empty and page_size defaults to 100. Occupancy requires a nonnull threshold; export and summary accept only absent/null threshold.

HistoryThreshold.description: Finite float64 in its original raw unit. No S-meter calibration conversion is implied.

HistoryViewportCell.description: Original source frequency, float64 level and point index of the FIRST maximum in this display bucket; preserve raw level unit from the parent row and the sign of zero.

HistoryViewportCursor.description: Immutable viewport boundary and query identity, including the original measurement cursor. Never substitute the latest boundary when replaying.

HistoryViewportPage.description: Derived bounded waterfall page, never a replacement for canonical raw arrays. Paging is frozen to its source boundary/query identity; maximum encoded result is 2 MiB.

HistoryViewportQuery.description: Bounded display projection: columns*rows must not exceed 32768. Frequency bounds are nonnegative signed64 integer Hz and ordered; UTC microsecond time bounds are half-open and ordered. Omit null time parameters from the HTTP query. Calendar/filter validation can reject unrepresentable timestamps even though codecs preserve every int64 value.

rbw_hz.description: The receive profile accepts exactly 10000 or 30000 Hz; profile-specific validation is authoritative.
